text: dsh-plugin-chatgpt-crash-fix 是一个面向 Windows 的 DSH 插件，通过 /chatgpt-crash-fix 命令提供 ChatGPT/Codex 桌面应用闪退排查手册，并定位随包提供的 PowerShell 脚本。它可检查应用安装状态和崩溃转储、检测 Windows Update 通道与系统代理配置，并提供添加微软域名代理绕过项及恢复原设置的脚本。适合 Windows 桌面应用在启动后异常退出、需要排查商店更新或代理问题的用户。使用需 Windows PowerShell；插件命令展示手册和脚本位置，诊断或修复需按步骤调用相应脚本。

dsh-plugin-chatgpt-crash-fix troubleshoots ChatGPT/Codex desktop crashes on Windows. Its /chatgpt-crash-fix command points to a playbook and PowerShell scripts to inspect crash reports, check Windows Update and proxy settings, and apply or roll back a Microsoft-domain proxy bypass.
我的 Windows 桌面应用打开一会儿就自动退出，怎么查原因？
想检查 ChatGPT 桌面版的崩溃转储和应用安装状态。
Windows Update 扫描失败，怎么判断是不是系统代理造成的？
帮我查看 Windows 更新服务和微软更新端点是否能连通。
How can I check whether a system proxy is interfering with Windows Update?
My Windows desktop app closes shortly after launch; how can I inspect its crash reports?
dsh-plugin-chatgpt-crash-fix 的「闪退诊断」脚本汇总 Windows 应用状态、崩溃转储、更新通道和代理信息，输出分节报告。运行 diagnose-chatgpt-crash.ps1。
dsh-plugin-chatgpt-crash-fix 的「更新通道检查」脚本检查相关服务、执行 WU 扫描并测试微软端点连通性，输出检查结果。运行 check-store-channel.ps1。
dsh-plugin-chatgpt-crash-fix 的功能「代理绕过修复与恢复」：修复脚本先备份当前代理配置，再将微软域名加入绕过列表并检查 WU 扫描；指定 -Restore 时可从备份恢复代理值。
系统代理开着时，微软商店更新通道连不上，怎么排查？
Can I add Microsoft domains to my proxy bypass list and restore the previous settings later?

Fully reproducible and rollback-safe.

dsh-plugin-chatgpt-crash-fix README · Problem：The ChatGPT desktop app on Windows opens fine, then the **whole process tree exits after ~60-90 seconds** with no system error dialog. The app log shows `[windows-store-updater] Checking Windows Store for package updates` right before it dies. Often triggered after an **interrupted Windows update** or after enabling a **Clash-style system proxy**.

dsh-plugin-chatgpt-crash-fix README · Root cause (verified via crash dumps)：```
Clash-style software sets a system proxy (e.g. 127.0.0.1:7897)
  └─ proxy fails to forward Microsoft update domains (direct works, via-proxy fails)
       └─ Windows Update / Microsoft Store channel breaks (0x80072EFD)
            └─ the app's Store-updater native module windows-updater.node crashes (0xC0000005)

dsh-plugin-chatgpt-crash-fix README · Fix (best of both worlds)：Keep the proxy on (OpenAI traffic stays proxied — avoids account-ban risk), and add **Microsoft domains to the proxy bypass list** so Store/Update go direct. The channel recovers, the app updates to a fixed build and stops crashing.

dsh-plugin-chatgpt-crash-fix README · Contents：| Item | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `skills/chatgpt-crash-fix/SKILL.md` | Playbook that teaches any DSH agent the diagnose → fix → verify flow |
| `scripts/diagnose-chatgpt-crash.ps1` | One-shot read-only diagnosis: app state, crash dumps, Store channel, proxy |
| `scripts/check-store-channel.ps1` | Store / Windows Update channel check (read-only) |
| `scripts/check-proxy-config.ps1` | Proxy + bypass-list check (read-only) |
| `scripts/fix-proxy-bypass.ps1` | One-command fix: backup → add MS bypass → verify (with `-Restore`) |
| `lib/index.js` | Cordis plugin registering the `/chatgpt-crash-fix` command |

```

text: dsh-plugin-chatgpt-crash-fix README · Usage：```powershell
dsh-plugin-chatgpt-crash-fix README · 1) Diagnose (read-only)：powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\diagnose-chatgpt-crash.ps1
dsh-plugin-chatgpt-crash-fix README · 2) If it reports "WU failed + proxy on + no MS bypass", fix：powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\fix-proxy-bypass.ps1 -ProxyServer "127.0.0.1:7897"
section: 2) If it reports "WU failed + proxy on + no MS bypass", fix

text:
dsh-plugin-chatgpt-crash-fix README · 3) Rollback：powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\fix-proxy-bypass.ps1 -Restore
```

dsh-plugin-chatgpt-crash-fix README · Verified outcome：- Crash dump triage pinpointed the faulting module: `...\resources\native\windows-updater.node` (0xC0000005).
- After adding the MS bypass list: WU scan recovered, the app updated via the Store (26.818.2441.0 → 26.818.5229.0), it stays running, and the updater log shows `overallState=NoUpdates`.
- Proxy kept on; OpenAI authentication works through it.
